Uttar Pradesh Subordinate Service Selection Commission (UPSSSC) is a government organization responsible for conducting recruitment exams for various government posts in Uttar Pradesh.

UPSSSC aims to provide opportunities for eligible candidates to join the government sector and contribute to the development of the state.

About the Programme

UPSSSC UP Excise Constable Recruitment 2026 is a government job opportunity for eligible candidates to join the excise department in Uttar Pradesh.

The programme aims to recruit 820 Excise Constables to work in the excise department and contribute to the state's revenue collection.
